title: The Keys
base_prompt: Colored stick figure, red shirt, blue pants, round white head, clean ink outlines, flat bright rooms.

characters.Hero: colored stick figure, red shirt, blue pants

scenes.vo: I need to leave in five minutes. Where are my keys?
scenes.image_prompt: Stick figure by the front door patting his pockets, empty key hook on the wall; sticky-note hook text.

scenes.vo: Not on the hook. Check the counter.
scenes.image_prompt: He checks the hook, then walks to the counter.

scenes.vo: Mail pile, coffee mug, one sock.
scenes.image_prompt: He lifts the mail pile and a green sock is under it.

scenes.vo: Why is there a sock here?
scenes.image_prompt: He holds the sock up, purple question mark.

scenes.vo: The sink has a plate I should rinse.
scenes.image_prompt: The sink with one plate in it, no figure.

scenes.vo: Wait, the trash needs to go out.
scenes.image_prompt: He grabs a full black trash bag.

scenes.vo: The bag rips. Trash on the floor.
scenes.image_prompt: The bag rips and colorful trash scatters on the floor.

scenes.vo: The car. I'm supposed to be in the car.
scenes.image_prompt: He looks out the window at the blue car, then back at the mess.

scenes.vo: One hour later, I'm sweeping the kitchen, the trash is still by the door,
scenes.image_prompt: Dark purple abstract: rainbow spiral around a racing clock; keys, sock, trash bag and question mark orbit.

scenes.vo: and my keys were in my pocket the whole time.
scenes.image_prompt: Sweeping the floor, then pulls the keys out of his pocket, deadpan.

scenes.vo: If that's your brain too, one thing works for me.
scenes.image_prompt: Smiling to camera in a purple room.

scenes.vo: Keys go in the same bowl the second I walk in. One spot.
scenes.image_prompt: Drops the keys into a bowl on a stool by the door; green check.

scenes.vo: Psalm 46:10 says, "Be still, and know that I am God."
My keys get one place. God gets the first minute. The car can wait.
scenes.image_prompt: Calm by the door, keys in the bowl, golden light; loops to the opening.
